_comment: v0.2.100 W5R-04: the ONE argv shape for syncing a single extra code-graph path. Asserted by vct-launcher-core db::codegraph_extras::extra_path_sync_args (Rust, panel Sync button) AND vco_lib.codegraph_extras_refresh.build_extra_sync_argv (Python, automatic Stop-drain refresh). Edit both sides together. The stale_cases table pins the shared 'needs a re-index' rule (Rust extra_path_is_stale / Python extra_path_is_stale): stale iff the repo HEAD is known and differs from last_indexed_commit. v0.2.100: every case carries --as-extra-path (the analyzer then never deletes a row not provably stamped with this path, e.g. a legacy primary row with an empty project_source). v0.2.102 W6-CGD: a case with primary_root carries --primary-root <project folder> right after --as-extra-path, so the analyzer refuses an extra path that overlaps the project (vco_lib.codegraph_extra_overlap); primary_root null emits no flag.

cases.name: full pass (incremental off) with the project folder
incremental with last indexed commit with the project folder

queued_cases._comment: v0.2.102 S16-7: the per-edit queued drain (refresh_queued / --queued) runs the analyzer with the extra's OWN collection args in scoped --only-files-from mode: build_extra_sync_argv(path, prefix, False, None, primary_root) + ['--only-files-from', <list file>]. The analyzer rejects --incremental combined with --only-files-from, so the queued argv never carries it; the commit is NOT recorded by the queued drain (the commit-stamp path owns last_indexed_commit).
queued_cases.name: queued drain over edited files
